title: 146 Stillorgan Road, Donnybrook, Dublin 4
description: **Available Immediately** **Unfurnished** Sherry FitzGerald Lettings presents this lovely home in the heart of Donnybrook. Situated just off the N11 and extending to approx. 175sqm, the property has been refurbished to a high standard with a refurbished kitchen and patio area. Stillorgan Road is in the heart of Dublin 4 with a choice of amenities on your doorstep. There are local transport routes within walking distance. Accommodation in brief: entrance hall leading to open plan living area; bright modern kitchen with utility just off; a downstairs bathroom just off the second living area; at the front of the home is a smaller room again which could act as an office room; upstairs there are four double bedrooms with ample built in wardrobe space and beautifully decorated modernised bathrooms. Ample parking in driveway for three cars. The rear garden is laid out mostly in lawn with high shrubs and trees with a sunny patio. **VIEWING VERY HIGHLY RECOMMENDED OF THIS PREMIUM HOME**
